l4_steps.name: Verify passenger allowance in PSS
l4_steps.input: Passenger PNR, ticket class, frequent flyer tier
l4_steps.output: Baggage allowance entitlement confirmed; excess fee notification triggered
l4_steps.kpi: Allowance lookup time ≤10 sec; fee notification accuracy ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa allowance rules do not sync in real-time with codeshare partner PSS, forcing manual overrides and creating revenue leakage on interline itineraries

l4_steps.name: Weigh and measure baggage at counter
l4_steps.system: SITA Common Use Terminal Equipment (CUTE) with integrated scale
l4_steps.output: Weight and dimension record; excess baggage charge calculated
l4_steps.kpi: Average bag acceptance time ≤90 sec per bag; scale accuracy ±0.1 kg
l4_steps.pain_point: Scale calibration drift at high-volume counters causes inconsistent weight readings; CUTE has no automated recalibration alert, so discrepancies are caught only during periodic QA audits

l4_steps.name: Collect excess baggage fees
l4_steps.input: Excess weight or piece determination from step 1.2
l4_steps.output: Fee collected and recorded in PNR; EMD (Electronic Miscellaneous Document) issued
l4_steps.kpi: Excess fee collection rate ≥98% of chargeable bags
l4_steps.pain_point: Agents waiving fees at discretion without supervisory approval triggers revenue leakage estimated at $30–50 per waived bag; Altéa has no mandatory approval workflow for fee waivers at Level 1 agent access

l4_steps.name: Print bag tag and transmit BSM
l4_steps.output: IATA 10-digit barcode bag tag affixed; Baggage Source Message (BSM) transmitted to BHS and destination airport
l4_steps.kpi: BSM transmission accuracy ≥99.5%; BSM delivery to BHS ≤5 sec
l4_steps.pain_point: BSM transmission lag >30 sec to downstream stations causes missed sortation windows on tight connections; IATA Resolution 753 mandates scan tracking from this point but most carriers lack RFID at check-in, relying on barcode-only

l4_steps.name: Induct bag into automated EDS screening
l4_steps.system: Smiths Detection CTX / L3 ProVision Explosive Detection System (EDS)
l4_steps.input: Tagged bag inducted onto inline conveyor belt with BSM
l4_steps.output: Bag inducted into screening lane; screening initiated
l4_steps.kpi: Screening throughput ≥1,200 bags/hr per lane; induction reject rate ≤0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Legacy inline EDS at secondary airports cannot handle post-pandemic capacity surge; single-lane configurations create 20–30 min queue backlogs during peak departures, directly causing departure delays

l4_steps.name: Evaluate automated threat detection result
l4_steps.system: Smiths Detection EDS console / L3 Technologies automated threat recognition (ATR)
l4_steps.input: CT scan image and ATR algorithm output
l4_steps.output: Clear or Suspect determination; bag status updated in screening system
l4_steps.pain_point: CT systems generate 10–15% false-positive rates for dense consumer items (lithium batteries, laptops), driving manual inspection queues that delay affected bags by 8–15 min and disrupt sortation sequence

l4_steps.name: Conduct manual bag search and resolve status
l4_steps.system: TSA PARIS (Passenger and Baggage Reconciliation) / SITA WorldTracer
l4_steps.input: Suspect bag flagged by ATR; passenger paged if required
l4_steps.output: Cleared, held, or offloaded determination; bag status updated; airline notified
l4_steps.kpi: Manual resolution time ≤15 min per bag; offload-to-notification time ≤5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated link between TSA PARIS resolution status and airline BHS sortation system; cleared bags require a manual phone call to ground ops to re-inject, introducing misrouting risk and operator dependency during irregular operations

l4_steps.name: Sort bag to destination make-up area via BHS
l4_steps.system: SITA BagManager / Airport BHS (Vanderlande BAGTRAX / Siemens automated sorter)
l4_steps.input: BSM data, flight departure time, make-up area assignment
l4_steps.output: Bag routed to correct make-up carousel or transfer belt
l4_steps.kpi: Sortation accuracy ≥99.7%; late bags to make-up ≤1% of total
l4_steps.pain_point: BHS sorter reading errors on damaged, bent, or folded barcoded bag tags cause misroutes; RFID fallback absent at most secondary airports despite IATA Resolution 753 requirement for 4-scan tracking — misrouted bags have no automated recovery path

l4_steps.name: Build ULD or loose-load baggage cart
l4_steps.input: Sorted bags arriving at make-up area; ULD build plan from load controller
l4_steps.output: Loaded ULD or baggage cart with physical manifest; weight estimate recorded
l4_steps.kpi: ULD build completion ≥30 min before scheduled departure; weight estimate variance ≤2%
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual ULD build-up has no real-time weight tracking — ramp agents estimate bag weight by handling; cumulative error causes load rebalancing at aircraft hold, adding avg 4–8 min to departure preparation

l4_steps.name: Reconcile bag count against active PAX list
l4_steps.system: SITA BagManager / Amadeus Altéa Departure Control System (DCS)
l4_steps.input: Loaded ULD manifest; active (boarded + checked-in) passenger list
l4_steps.output: Bag count confirmed or discrepancy flagged for investigation
l4_steps.kpi: Pre-load reconciliation accuracy ≥99.5%; discrepancy resolution time ≤10 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Disconnected systems between check-in (Altéa DCS) and ramp (BagManager) mean reconciliation relies on manual counts at make-up; count gaps widen at off-hub outstations with limited IT infrastructure and no dedicated ramp IT support

l4_steps.name: Transport ULDs and carts to aircraft
l4_steps.system: SITA Airport Management System (AMS) / Ramp Resource Management
l4_steps.input: Departure time, gate assignment, confirmed ULD manifest
l4_steps.output: ULDs delivered to aircraft within loading window
l4_steps.kpi: Bags at aircraft ≥25 min before scheduled departure; tug utilisation ≥80%
l4_steps.pain_point: Late gate changes (≤15 min before departure) force ULD re-routing on congested apron without automated rerouting guidance; ramp agents coordinate via radio only, causing ULD queuing conflicts and delay attribution to ground ops

l4_steps.name: Load baggage into aircraft hold per W&B plan
l4_steps.system: Jeppesen LoadPlanner / Ultramain Weight & Balance System
l4_steps.input: ULD manifest, aircraft hold configuration, W&B loading sequence
l4_steps.output: Bags loaded per load plan; hold positions recorded; loading confirmation sent to load controller
l4_steps.kpi: Hold loading complete ≥15 min before departure (D-15); W&B CG within ±1% of plan
l4_steps.pain_point: Real-time W&B updates require accurate bag weights from check-in; estimated weights (used when CUTE scales drift) increase fuel burn by 0.1–0.3% per flight and may require unplanned last-minute cargo offload to maintain CG envelope

l4_steps.name: Reconcile loaded bags and offload no-shows
l4_steps.system: SITA BagManager / Amadeus Altéa Departure Control System (DCS)
l4_steps.input: Final loaded bag count; departure passenger list (after boarding gate closes)
l4_steps.output: Load sheet signed off; no-fly bags identified and physically offloaded; NOTOC updated
l4_steps.kpi: 100% reconciliation before door closure; unaccompanied bag offload ≤10 min from identification
l4_steps.pain_point: ICAO Annex 17 requires offloading bags of passengers who check in but do not board; manual hold search for no-show bags averages 8–12 min delay per occurrence and is non-negotiable — no technology currently automates the physical search

l4_steps.name: Offload baggage from aircraft on arrival
l4_steps.system: SITA Airport Management System (AMS) / SITA BagManager
l4_steps.output: All bags offloaded; scan event logged per IATA Resolution 753 4-point tracking requirement
l4_steps.kpi: First bag on belt ≤20 min from block-in (domestic); ≤25 min (international)
l4_steps.pain_point: Short-turn flights (≤45 min ground time) require simultaneous offload and inbound load operations; ramp agents coordinate only via radio with no automated sequencing tool, increasing error rate and first-bag time during high-rotation operations

l4_steps.name: Deliver bags to assigned baggage claim belt
l4_steps.system: SITA BagManager / Airport BHS claim belt controller / FIDS
l4_steps.input: Offloaded bags; belt assignment from airport ops; flight arrival data
l4_steps.output: Bags on reclaim belt; passenger belt notification displayed on FIDS
l4_steps.kpi: Last bag on belt ≤35 min from block-in; on-time belt delivery rate ≥92%
l4_steps.pain_point: Belt assignment conflicts during irregular operations (multiple delayed arrivals simultaneously) cause commingling of bags from different flights; commingling increases WorldTracer PIR filings by ~30% during IROPS windows and triggers EC 261/2004 and DOT compensation exposure

l4_steps.name: Identify and file PIR for mishandled bags
l4_steps.input: Unclaimed bags at belt; passenger self-report; gap in IATA Resolution 753 scan trail
l4_steps.output: Property Irregularity Report (PIR) filed in WorldTracer; passenger notified with file reference
l4_steps.kpi: PIR filing time ≤10 min from passenger report; mishandling rate ≤5 per 1,000 passengers (IATA industry target)
l4_steps.pain_point: Missing intermediate scans (induction, sortation, or loading) leave no audit trail for liability disputes under EC 261/2004 and DOT baggage rules; WorldTracer matching fails without a complete scan history, leaving agents unable to locate bag origin or last-seen point

l4_steps.name: Trace, recover and return mishandled baggage
l4_steps.system: SITA WorldTracer / baggage delivery partner (Deliver.com / BagsVIP)
l4_steps.input: PIR record; scan history; last-known location from BagManager
l4_steps.output: Bag located; delivery to passenger arranged; WorldTracer case closed
l4_steps.kpi: 80% of mishandled bags returned within 24 hrs; permanently lost bag rate ≤0.5 per 1,000 passengers
l4_steps.pain_point: WorldTracer matching depends on accurate IATA barcode scans; damaged tags with no RFID fallback leave bags stranded in 'no-read' queues at transfer hubs with no automated escalation workflow — cases age beyond 5-day threshold, triggering DOT delayed baggage compensation requirements
